blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Audit (COA) has flagged the Bureau of Customs (BOC) over a mismatch in records of confiscated assets, including 52 seized vehicles in Port of Manila (POM) worth over a billion pesos. In its 2025 audit report for BOC uploaded to COA website on Oct. 21, the state auditor said the vehicles were listed as seized, but the records are either incomplete or the corresponding report was not submitted. “Included in the noted discrepancies are 52 confiscated vehicles under the POM with an estimated value of P1.292 billion,” the COA said.
